critical_wet_dry_regime.interpretation: One additional 10-cm state immediately above 140 cm removes most, but not all, of the wet-to-dry redistribution error without changing the published LARE interface closure.

scientific_interpretation: The large D3 wet-dry error is not purely an invariant or mass-conservation failure.
Vertical resolution near the lower active zone materially controls standard-LARE redistribution fidelity.
D4 does not establish application acceptance; its remaining worst-case common-band error is about 6.88 mm.

P1 state-separation saturation beyond D4 does not imply propagation fidelity saturation: a representation can add little collision separation yet materially improve a nonlinear closure by localizing the state used at an interface.
The next diagnostic must separate mean-state constitutive averaging from interface-gradient reconstruction before adding more state dimensions.

coarse_richards.reason: D3 and D2 coarse Richards dynamic cases remain blocked through the preregistered temporal qualification ladder; only equilibrium cases qualify.
